messages:
anya: Morning folks — quick async huddle. SDK docs + quickstarts + samplekit CI.
anya: What I did: fixed TypeScript typings in node SDK, updated quickstart for serverless deploy, filed a flaky test in samplekit (#412).
anya: Blockers: samplekit e2e flakes on macOS runners — can't reproduce locally. need someone with mac to triage. also need a review on the TS typings PR.
anya: Today: triage flakes, nudge reviewers, cut a small docs patch for runtime options.
sam: I can repro the macOS flake on my M1. dropping logs in the ticket now. rough trace looks like a timing issue in the test harness.
sam: also leaving a review on the TS typings PR (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789)
taylor: Thanks Sam. I’ll try a local run with --runInBand and see if jest parallelism is the cause.
taylor: FYI I pushed a tiny wording tweak to the quickstart about env var names — nothing blocking, just UX.
marcus: Re: review — I can do a deep pass on typings after lunch. If it's small we can merge and ship a patch release.
marcus: For samplekit flaky test, idea: add a short retry wrapper around the HTTP call in the e2e for now, and create a follow-up to clean up later.
anya: Good plan. If we add retry, let's keep it small (3 attempts) and log the intermediate failures so we know it's a flake not a regression.
anya: docs-bot: can you remind the team of the release checklist when we cut the patch? :slightly_smiling_face:
docs-bot: @channel release checklist: update changelog, bump package.json patch, run smoke tests, publish to npm, update docs site. See /docs/release-guide.
sam: Quick command I'll run for a local smoke: ```npm run build && npm pack && npm install ../sdk-1.2.3.tgz && node examples/basic.js``` — will share results.
taylor: If anyone is blocked on reviewers, ping me in-thread and I’ll escalate. :thumbsup:
anya: Outstanding asks: (1) someone with mac to post full failing log in ticket, (2) Marcus to review typings PR, (3) add tiny retry in samplekit e2e and link PR.
anya: I'll follow up mid-afternoon with a status update here. Thanks all :rocket:
